authoring: Expected semantics derived from FINAL_BASELINE.json before inspecting application code. Inputs and outputs use domain-level operation names; responses may use equivalent public representations.

conventions.reasonCodes: Order-independent. A historical run can retain its own evidence reasons where the current behavior’s primary reason references that run.
conventions.aliases: Saved aliases refer to original responses or entities. A receipt replay compares receipt identity and stored content, not a fabricated UUID.
conventions.time: Fixed server UTC. Tests advance only when specified. Freeze report records its assessment time.
conventions.errorLabels: Named in fixture for expected semantics. Check the actual system action, not exact HTTP status or diagnostic phrasing unless the source baseline requires it.
conventions.logicalDataRows: Number from one after the header. Preserve the actual application’s logical/physical diagnostics and link conventions.
